findings.evidence: In this file, `polynomialSimplicialResolution` has no `_def` or `map` lemma; δ/σ lemmas exist only at `Fin 2` and `Fin 1`; all three proofs begin `dsimp only [polynomialSimplicialResolution]`.
findings.fix: Add `polynomialSimplicialResolution_def : polynomialSimplicialResolution R = (polynomialComonad R).simplicialResolution := (rfl)`. Add specialized lemmas for faces and degeneracies at all degrees and for `map_app`, or make the definition an `abbrev`.
findings.issue: `polynomialSimplicialResolution` is a non-reducible `def` with no `_def` lemma. The generic `simplicialResolution_δ/σ/map_app` simp lemmas can't fire on it, and only the degree-1 δ and degree-0 σ are restated, so users in higher degrees must unfold it (the file's own proofs use `dsimp only [polynomialSimplicialResolution]`).

findings.evidence: Grep for `fromSimplexCategory` finds only the def, `_obj`, `_map_δ`, `_map_σ` and two uses in `SimplicialResolution.lean`; the body is `map f := toSimplexCategory.preimage f`, so the section lemma follows from `map_preimage`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] toSimplexCategory_map_fromSimplexCategory_map (f) : toSimplexCategory.map (fromSimplexCategory.map f) = f` and `fromSimplexCategory_comp_toSimplexCategory : fromSimplexCategory ⋙ toSimplexCategory = 𝟭 _` (or an iso), plus the reverse composite as an iso.
findings.issue: `fromSimplexCategory` is presented as the inverse presentation functor, but its defining property is never stated. Its only API is on generators (`_obj`, `_map_δ`, `_map_σ`), so users cannot reason about arbitrary morphisms or relate it to the `IsEquivalence` instance without unfolding the exposed body.

summary: Two characteristic-API gaps: the new polynomial resolution has no bridge to the generic API beyond degree one, and the new inverse presentation functor has no lemma stating that it is a section of `toSimplexCategory`.
